lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. The decision asked of Brandon in Status 236 at about 5:20 PM MT Friday stands unanswered: move on to the film and the masters, or one more round of looks first. The work goes on in either case and only the freeze waits.

Chain 42 passed and is on main since 02:18 UTC (7:18 PM MT Friday): spring's glass carries its drops and runs after a shake. Measured by the chain's helper on the merged tree: type check and build exit 0, engine dc59c0d7c2daa6ab, seven guard pictures equal and spring after a shake alone moved, the measures of the change of season equal to chain 41's, the whole test run 1061 passed and 8 skipped. Measured here: the moved picture's hash equals its builder's, and the picture was looked at. Not on the live page yet: the fourteenth publish is being prepared now (its first pictures are being drawn, then the build, the security review and the live check). Below the bar still: the trails are pale on pale at the landing, one bunch sits at the upper right, and no run shows from film frame 684 to 700.

Summer's fireflies at 4K (item 276): the first pair of pictures is in, nothing pushed. Seen here at film frame 1440: the wide flat bars of main are single fine streaks that go out softly in the trial. At film frame 1470, where the ball stands nearly still, the two differ little, and one light is a row of four beads in both, cause not found. Decision 255: the direction is taken. Floors: no streak fainter at its peak than before, the colour stays yellow green, the width at 4K may be slimmed as a second step of its own, and the beads' cause is looked for.

The petals' weave (item 278): the five proof frames at 4K with the last mend on its pushed head are in, drawn on five helper machines (53 to 80 samples a frame, 12 to 16 minutes each). Looked at here at full size: single soft smears and no ribs at film frames 1388 and 1389. At three times a fine dotted grain shows along some dark edges, and one dotted patch at frame 2121, to be read against main's frames, which are being drawn now. Stated by its builder so far: the whole test run 1058 passed and 8 skipped, the eight guards equal, six control frames the same bytes with and without the mend. Not merged.

The final render on his own computer. Decision 256: the test of the send back step may run on a hosted Windows machine, with stand in files of a few bytes only. The builder's guess for the last report of the one file moved to about 4:30 AM MT Saturday, because the send back step adds about two and a half hours. The Direct3D mend's whole is due about 9:11 PM MT. No final render is started in the cloud.

Remaining in phase 6 and what he receives. The fourteenth publish at the same address: spring's glass after a shake. Chain 43: the petals' weave, the frost line at film frame 668, summer's fireflies and the seeds' dots, as each passes. Chain 44: the stall's mend (reports due about 8:40 PM and 9:20 PM MT) and the Direct3D mend. Then a critic for the change of season and a fifteenth publish. The render instructions: one file in the repo and one line to give Claude Code. On his word the freeze: the repo goes private and the references are redrawn. Then the film steps of the build order and the full 4K 60 render on his gaming PC on his word: With Prompt and Without Prompt at 3840x2160, the Portfolio Looping Video and the Portfolio Screenshot. Last, a fresh reviewer's score against the showcase standard.

Open, below the bar: summer's landing streaks whiter and coarser than approved and its base darker. Summer's pond at rest (item 279). Fall's storm paler than approved. Spring's glass after a shake pale on pale (on main, not live yet). Spring's fence and trails. The fireflies' flat bars at 4K (item 276, a trial). The seeds' lumps of dots at the stills' close camera (item 277). The petals' weave at film frames 1388 and 1389 (item 278, in proof). The frost line at film frame 668 (item 275). The stall at low quality on a software renderer. Winter's four small items. Fall's near fence and the pumpkin's stepped face (item 272). The petals' fringe at film frame 680. The poster tool that stops on one failed request (item 273).
Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000 (measured from the ledger at 02:20 UTC: 52 calls), no call since 05:47 UTC on Thursday (10:47 PM MT Wednesday). No film render and no new preview since Preview 07.
